Shows monotonic accuracy decline across three model families,
supporting cross-model generalizability of Dimension 1.
"""
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import os

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 8,
    'axes.labelsize': 9,
    'axes.titlesize': 9,
    'xtick.labelsize': 7.5,
    'ytick.labelsize': 7.5,
    'legend.fontsize': 7,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.03,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'axes.linewidth': 0.6,
    'xtick.major.width': 0.6,
    'ytick.major.width': 0.6,
    'pdf.fonttype': 42,
    'ps.fonttype': 42,
})

C_QWEN = '#3B6CB5'
C_LLAMA = '#ED7D31'
C_GEMINI = '#27AE60'

counts_qwen = [4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 80]
acc_qwen = [0.870, 0.805, 0.719, 0.652, 0.539, 0.504]

counts_llama70 = [8, 16, 32, 64, 80]
acc_llama70 = [0.757, 0.685, 0.601, 0.504, 0.450]

counts_gemini = [4, 8, 16, 32, 64]
acc_gemini = [0.873, 0.820, 0.787, 0.739, 0.637]

        label='Qwen3-32B', zorder=3)
ax.plot(counts_llama70, acc_llama70, 's--', color=C_LLAMA, ms=4, lw=1.3,
        label='Llama-3.1-70B', zorder=3)

        label='Gemini 2.5 Flash', zorder=3, markeredgewidth=0.5)

ax.set_ylabel('Accuracy')
ax.set_ylim(0.38, 0.95)
ax.set_xticks([4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 80])
ax.set_xticklabels(['4', '8', '16', '32', '64', '80'])

          handlelength=1.8, borderpad=0.4)

A natural intervention is to partition the schema so confusable types never co-occur (Figure~\ref{fig:sdgd_pipeline}). We tested Schema-DAG-Guided Decomposition (SDGD), which applies greedy graph coloring on the SCS graph to assign types to low-confusability batches. While oracle routing recovers accuracy (0.724 vs.\ 0.504 single-pass; Table~\ref{tab:routing_strategies}), all practical routing strategies fall below the single-pass baseline, and NER decomposition amplifies false positives (F1: 0.445$\to$0.251). Merge amplification is the structural bottleneck: union merge doubles false positives (precision: 0.56$\to$0.21) while voting merge sacrifices recall. Confusability-aware batch composition avoids routing entirely and achieves higher accuracy under oracle assignment (Appendix~\ref{sec:appendix_batch_composition}). Full protocol in Appendix~\ref{sec:appendix_sdgd}.
